facts.statement: The genus Leptonectes was previously known by the synonym Leptopterygius, which was named by Huene in 1929.
Fossils of Leptonectes have been found in Belgium, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom.
facts.quote: Fossils have been found in Belgium, Germany, Spain and the United Kingdom.

facts.statement: The type species Leptonectes tenuirostris reached a length of 4 meters.
facts.quote: the type species, L. tenuirostris, reached 4 m long

facts.statement: The species Leptonectes moorei likely reached a length of 3 meters.
facts.quote: L. moorei (NHMUK PV R 14370) likely reached 3 m long

facts.statement: The largest species, Leptonectes solei, was approximately 5 to 6 meters long.
facts.quote: the largest species, L. solei, was approximately 5 - 6 m long

facts.statement: Leptonectes was an ichthyosaur that lived from the Late Triassic to the Early Jurassic (Rhaetian to Pliensbachian).
facts.quote: Leptonectes es un género de ictiosaurio que vivió desde finales del Triásico al Jurásico Temprano (Rhaetiense - Pliensbachiano).

facts.statement: Leptonectes was a medium-sized ichthyosaur, about 4 meters long, with a skull occupying less than 1 meter of that length.
facts.quote: Leptonectes era un ictiosaurio de tamaño mediano, con una longitud de unos 4 metros, de los que el cráneo ocupa menos de 1 metro.

facts.statement: It is currently debated whether Leptonectes is a monophyletic taxon or a paraphyletic group of basal ichthyosaurs not included in Eurhinosauria, as it lacks a defining synapomorphy.
facts.quote: En la actualidad, el tipo de Leptonectes no está definido por ninguna sinapomorfia, y por lo tanto no puede determinarse si es un taxón monofilético o un grupo parafilético de ictiosaurios basales no incluidos en Eurhinosauria.

facts.statement: Leptonectes lived from the Rhaetian to the Toarcian, between 205.7 and 182.9 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Rhaetian to Toarcian (205.7 to 182.9 million years ago)

rejected.statement: The genus Leptonectes was established by McGowan in 1996.
